_note: STIG Checker baseline for the JANET Web 'stig' tool. Hand-edit this file to add/remove/adjust checks; the tool reads it FRESH on every scan and NEVER writes it. Each check: id, title, severity (CAT I/II/III), hive (HKLM|HKCU), path (no hive prefix), value (the value name), comparison (eq|ge|exists), expected OR expectedOneOf, missingIs (Compliant|Open) = the verdict when the value/key is absent, note (one-liner). All values compared numerically when both sides parse as integers, else as strings.

checks.title: SMBv1 server protocol disabled
checks.note: SMBv1 is deprecated and exploitable (EternalBlue); the LanmanServer SMB1 value must be 0. Absent = not explicitly disabled.

checks.title: LAN Manager authentication level NTLMv2 only
checks.note: LmCompatibilityLevel 5 = send NTLMv2 only, refuse LM and NTLM. Anything lower weakens auth.

checks.title: Do not store LAN Manager hash on password change
checks.note: NoLMHash must be 1 so the weak LM hash is never stored.

checks.title: Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares
checks.note: RestrictAnonymous 1 blocks anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts and shares (WN10-SO-000145, CAT I).

checks.title: Restrict anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts
checks.note: RestrictAnonymousSAM 1 stops anonymous SAM account/share enumeration.

checks.title: Restrict anonymous access to Named Pipes and Shares
checks.note: RestrictNullSessAccess 1 blocks anonymous access to the Named Pipes and Shares listed in NullSessionPipes/NullSessionShares (WN10-SO-000150, CAT I).

checks.title: User Account Control (Admin Approval Mode) enabled
checks.note: EnableLUA 1 keeps UAC on; 0 disables the entire UAC boundary.

checks.title: UAC elevation prompt for administrators on the secure desktop
checks.note: ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin 2 = prompt for consent on the secure desktop; 1 = prompt for credentials on the secure desktop (stricter). Either value satisfies the control.

checks.title: PowerShell Script Block Logging enabled
checks.note: Captures deobfuscated script blocks to the event log for hunting/forensics.

checks.title: PowerShell Module Logging enabled
checks.note: Logs pipeline execution details for configured modules.

checks.title: Autorun disabled on all drive types
checks.note: NoDriveTypeAutoRun 255 (0xFF) disables Autorun on every drive type.

checks.title: Default Autorun behavior set to do-not-execute
checks.note: NoAutorun 1 prevents autorun.inf commands from executing automatically.

checks.title: WDigest cleartext credential caching disabled
checks.note: UseLogonCredential 0 keeps plaintext passwords out of LSASS; modern OS default is already secure when absent.

checks.title: RDP requires Network Level Authentication
checks.note: UserAuthentication 1 forces NLA so credentials are validated before a session is created. DISA (WN10-CC-000285) checks the GPO Policies key, which termsrv merges at runtime; the live WinStations\RDP-Tcp value is the wrong source on GPO-managed hosts.

checks.title: RDP minimum encryption level High or higher
checks.note: MinEncryptionLevel 3 (High) or 4 (FIPS) required for the RDP channel. DISA (WN10-CC-000290) checks the GPO Policies key; the live WinStations\RDP-Tcp value stays at its factory default 2 on GPO-managed hosts, so reading it caused false OPEN verdicts fleet-wide.

checks.title: Windows SmartScreen enabled
checks.note: Since Windows 10 1703 EnableSmartScreen is 0/1 (the block level moved to the ShellSmartScreenLevel string); 1 = SmartScreen on. WN10-CC-000210 also requires ShellSmartScreenLevel = Block (checked separately).

checks.title: Windows SmartScreen level set to Block
checks.note: Post-1703 companion to EnableSmartScreen: ShellSmartScreenLevel must be 'Block' (not 'Warn') per WN10-CC-000210.

checks.title: Microsoft Defender potentially-unwanted-app protection on
checks.note: PUAProtection 1 blocks bundled adware/PUA at the AV layer.

checks.title: TLS 1.0 client disabled (SCHANNEL)
checks.note: Deprecated TLS 1.0 client must be explicitly disabled (Enabled=0). NOTE: Windows 11 24H2+ disables TLS 1.0 by default without creating this key, so missing=Open may false-OPEN on 24H2; explicit Enabled=0 remains the remediation.

checks.title: TLS 1.0 server disabled (SCHANNEL)
checks.note: Deprecated TLS 1.0 server must be explicitly disabled (Enabled=0). NOTE: Windows 11 24H2+ disables TLS 1.0 by default without creating this key, so missing=Open may false-OPEN on 24H2; explicit Enabled=0 remains the remediation.

checks.title: TLS 1.1 client disabled (SCHANNEL)
checks.note: Deprecated TLS 1.1 client must be explicitly disabled (Enabled=0). NOTE: Windows 11 24H2+ disables TLS 1.1 by default without creating this key, so missing=Open may false-OPEN on 24H2; explicit Enabled=0 remains the remediation.

checks.title: TLS 1.1 server disabled (SCHANNEL)
checks.note: Deprecated TLS 1.1 server must be explicitly disabled (Enabled=0). NOTE: Windows 11 24H2+ disables TLS 1.1 by default without creating this key, so missing=Open may false-OPEN on 24H2; explicit Enabled=0 remains the remediation.

checks.title: Windows Installer AlwaysInstallElevated disabled (machine)
checks.note: Must be 0; value 1 lets any user install MSIs as SYSTEM. Elevation requires BOTH the HKLM and HKCU values = 1, so gating the machine half alone blocks the attack. Absent = feature off = compliant. (The HKCU half is not audited: over WinRM HKCU: is the scan credential's hive, not a real user's, so any per-user check here would be meaningless.)

checks.title: WinRM service disallows unencrypted traffic
checks.note: AllowUnencrypted 0 forces encrypted WinRM; default is secure when absent.

checks.title: WinRM service disallows Basic authentication
checks.note: AllowBasic 0 blocks cleartext-capable Basic auth on the WinRM listener.

checks.title: WinRM client disallows unencrypted traffic
checks.note: AllowUnencrypted 0 forces encrypted outbound WinRM; default is secure when absent.

checks.title: WinRM client disallows Basic authentication
checks.note: AllowBasic 0 blocks Basic auth for the WinRM client. Unlike the WinRM service, the client default is Basic = enabled when this policy value is absent, so missing = Open (WN10-CC-000330, CAT I).

checks.title: LDAP client signing negotiate-or-require
checks.note: LDAPClientIntegrity 1 (negotiate) or 2 (require) protects directory binds from tampering.

checks.title: SMB client packet signing required
checks.note: RequireSecuritySignature 1 forces the SMB client to sign, blocking relay/MITM.

checks.title: SMB server packet signing required
checks.note: RequireSecuritySignature 1 forces the SMB server to sign, blocking relay/MITM.

checks.title: Structured Exception Handling Overwrite Protection on
checks.note: DisableExceptionChainValidation 0 keeps SEHOP enabled; SEHOP is on by default when absent.

checks.title: LSA protection (RunAsPPL) enabled
checks.note: RunAsPPL 1/2 runs LSASS as a protected process, blocking credential theft (Credential Guard precursor).
